class: A multi-order hand-off whose execution order the vendor does not guarantee can place a dependent order (a sell) before the order it depends on (its hedge): margin is then computed on a naked short, and a far wing BUY can be refused outright. Correctness needs a structural split - two hand-offs, the second gated on the first's confirmed fills - never the order of a list.
mechanism: Kite Publisher baskets (kite.zerodha.com/connect/basket, used by backend/ofo_app/basket.py:57) are placed by parallel API calls (Zerodha staff, 2018); Kite's own web basket is sequential but is not our path. The Publisher returns no per-order status.

first_seen.where: GC-ICGUIDE planning, web research for the owner's automatic two-basket question
first_seen.evidence: https://kite.trade/forum/discussion/4917/basket-order-execution-order ('order of execution is not guaranteed'); https://kite.trade/docs/kite/orders/ (web basket sequential, buys first); https://kite.trade/forum/discussion/10230/basket-orders-execution-documentation-missing (far wing BUY refused until the sell was placed). spec/findings.md F-102.

fix: None this round: ADR-281 holds order placement. The future automatic-placement round must split each adjustment or exit into two hand-offs (hedges first, then the rest after the first's fills are read from the order book), per ADR-117, and prove the order with 2 non-filling LIMIT orders if the vendor statement is still unverified.

detection.note: No check: no code places orders automatically today (the user presses Execute on Kite, ADR-054/ADR-100). Unguarded until the two-hand-off split exists with a test.
